answer: Make admission cost real compute bound to the key: each identity mines a basalt-hard puzzle whose difficulty cannot be shared or batched, so every fake head pays a fresh solve and honest agents pay once. Chain each verified output into a public thread of prior hashes so work cannot be reordered or resold. Cluster response behavior each epoch: a coordinated fleet collapses into a nebula, and above a density cap the cluster reward is split among members, so the marginal fake lowers every other share. The attacker pays compute per head, ordering, and dilution.
